literal_meaning: পাশ ফিরে বা কাত হয়ে হয়ে ওঠা
figurative_meaning_en: to lie down sideways in distress or pain
similar_in_english: to be flat on one's back
example_sentences_in_bangla: পেটের ব্যথায় সে আড় হয়ে শুয়ে রইলো।
example_sentences_in_english: He's lying sideways due to fever.
She took to her bed sideways from stomach pain.
note: This idiom vividly describes physical discomfort in Bengali folk expressions.
